text:
ops-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: runtime queue depth spiking in us-west-2. p95 token latency -> 2.8s, in-flight at 94%. Auto-shed started but ingress still high. Paging on-call.
Alex R: on it. grabbing stack and traffic graphs. ETA 2m.
eng-oncall-bot: Pager routed to Alex R (on-call). Priority: high. Related: #customer-impact.
Alex R: quick check - is this single model or cross-model?
Morgan T: looks like embed endpoints + chat-p2 are spiking. embed-heavy customers show high concurrency.
Sasha L: hypothesis: upstream batch size change + one large customer burst. also seeing KV cache misses increase.
Alex R: plan: 1) tighten max-inflight on embed workers to 6 2) enable soft-shed for non-SLA tenants 3) temporarily disable experimental "prefetch-caching" on runtime. doing 1 now.
Priya S: thumbs. I'm on customer comms if we need to message top 10 customers.
Alex R: running command to reduce in-flight: `rctl set --pool embed-usw2 --max-inflight 6`
Morgan T: copy. I'll roll soft-shed policy: `policy apply soft_shed_non_sla --priority=low`
Sasha L: disabling prefetch-caching in prod: `kubectl set env deploy/rt-runtime PREFETCH_CACHE=false -n prod-usw2`
eng-oncall-bot: Action logs: rctl change succeeded at 1725001280. policy apply pending.
Alex R: seeing immediate drop in queue depth, p95 now 1.6s. But a tail group still queued.
Priya S: do we need a quota bump for any paying customers? I can offer temporary increased burst for specific accounts.
Morgan T: yes — customer C-42 is hitting rate cap; they're enterprise. Recommend whitelist burst 2x for 15m: `quota adjust C-42 --burst 2x --ttl 15m`
Alex R: applied. monitor.
Sasha L: re: timeout tuning — current worker timeout is 45s; for embed flows we can reduce to 30s to free slots faster. Proposing `timeout.set embed 30s`
Alex R: agreed, lowering to 30s now.
eng-oncall-bot: timeout change logged at 1725001515.
Alex R: after changes p99 latency down to 2.1s, in-flight 72%, 429s dropped by 60%. Good signal.
Priya S: drafted a short note to affected customers: "We're seeing high request volumes; we've applied temporary traffic shaping and increased burst for enterprise customers — you may see transient errors while we stabilize." Want me to send?
Morgan T: yes, send to top 10 and C-42 now. Include expected ETA 30m.
Priya S: sent.
Sasha L: follow-up: we should add an automated runtime circuit to disable prefetch-caching when queue > 80% for 2min. File a ticket?
Alex R: please create ticket and assign to eng-runtime. I'll leave the incident in monitoring mode for 1hr and then hand off to next on-call.
eng-oncall-bot: Incident pinned, status: mitigated -> monitoring. Handoff scheduled to next on-call in 59m.
Alex R: leaving notes in the incident doc: root cause likely upstream burst + a recently merged prefetch change. Next steps: revert prefetch or gating, long-term: per-tenant adaptive batching + quota autoscale.
Priya S: I'll follow-up with customer success for C-42 post-incident check-in.
Morgan T: agree. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
Alex R: handing off to Sasha for overnight watch. Sasha, please escalate if p95 > 2.5s for 10m.
Sasha L: got it. I'll keep eyes on dashboards and alerts.
eng-oncall-bot: thread closed for active pager; incident remains in monitoring."
